title: Oven Roasted Ukrainian Chicken Bowl
description: A sweet and dense Ukrainian dish featuring chicken breast, ferment-kimchi, and served in an earthenware bowl, this recipe is vegan-friendly by substituting chicken with a plant-based alternative.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, honey, apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the tofu to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 25 minutes.
While the tofu is roasting, heat the ferment-kimchi in a saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked brown rice between four earthenware bowls.
Add the roasted tofu on top of the rice.
Spoon the heated ferment-kimchi over the tofu.
